description: Spec §4.1 publishes a CLOSED FEL catalog of six bindings. A precondition that references an unregistered @name (here @bogus) MUST be rejected — FEL evaluators MUST emit an unbound-context-reference diagnostic. fel-core's ContextBindingCatalog trait + the EmptyCatalog fallback enforce this in the Rust evaluator; the formspec engine ships ResponseActionsPreconditionCatalog as the contract surface until the WASM bridge plumbs Rust catalogs end-to-end.
